data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER search_extraction_insert AFTER INSERT ON extractions BEGIN
  DELETE FROM search_index
    WHERE kind = 'extraction' AND recording_id = new.recording_id;
  INSERT INTO search_index (recording_id, kind, body)
    SELECT e.recording_id, 'extraction', group_concat(j.value, ' ')
    FROM extractions e, json_tree(e.json) j
    WHERE e.id = (SELECT e2.id FROM extractions e2
        WHERE e2.recording_id = new.recording_id
        ORDER BY e2.created_at DESC, e2.id DESC LIMIT 1)
      AND j.type = 'text'
    GROUP BY e.id;
END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recordings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NULL, "tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "consent_confirmed_at" INTEGER NULL, "import_attested_at" INTEGER NULL, "stop_reason" TEXT NULL, "recovered" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("recovered" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ask_threads" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recording_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recordings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ask_turns" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "thread_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ask_threads (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "question" TEXT NOT NULL, "answer" TEXT NOT NULL, "found" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("found" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("thread_id", "seq"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ask_citations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "turn_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ask_turns (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "recording_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "t_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TRIGGER ask_citation_delete AFTER DELETE ON ask_citations BEGIN DELETE FROM ask_turns WHERE id = old.turn_id;END
CREATE TRIGGER ask_turn_delete AFTER DELETE ON ask_turns BEGIN DELETE FROM ask_threads WHERE id = old.thread_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ask_turns WHERE thread_id = old.thread_id);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audio_chunks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "recording_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "sample_rate" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("recording_id", "seq"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "speech_segments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "recording_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "start_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "markers" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "recording_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "speakers" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "recording_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("recording_id", "label"));
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_index" USING fts5(recording_id UNINDEXED, kind UNINDEXED, body, tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2');

CREATE TRIGGER search_recording_insert AFTER INSERT ON recordings BEGIN INSERT INTO search_index (recording_id, kind, body) SELECT new.id, 'title', new.title || ' ' || COALESCE((SELECT group_concat(value, ' ') FROM json_each(new.tags)), '');END

CREATE TRIGGER search_recording_update AFTER UPDATE OF title, tags ON recordings BEGIN DELETE FROM search_index WHERE recording_id = new.id AND kind = 'title';INSERT INTO search_index (recording_id, kind, body) SELECT new.id, 'title', new.title || ' ' || COALESCE((SELECT group_concat(value, ' ') FROM json_each(new.tags)), '');END
CREATE TRIGGER search_recording_delete AFTER DELETE ON recordings BEGIN DELETE FROM search_index WHERE recording_id = old.id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transcripts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recording_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "model_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "language" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "edited" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("edited" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transcript_segments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "transcript_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transcripts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "speaker" TEXT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_text" TEXT NULL, "avg_logprob" REAL NULL, "tokens_json" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("transcript_id", "seq"));

CREATE TRIGGER search_segment_insert AFTER INSERT ON transcript_segments BEGIN INSERT INTO search_index ("rowid", recording_id, kind, body) SELECT -new.id, t.recording_id, 'transcript', new.body FROM transcripts AS t WHERE t.id = new.transcript_id;END

CREATE TRIGGER search_segment_update AFTER UPDATE OF body ON transcript_segments BEGIN DELETE FROM search_index WHERE "rowid" = -old.id;INSERT INTO search_index ("rowid", recording_id, kind, body) SELECT -new.id, t.recording_id, 'transcript', new.body FROM transcripts AS t WHERE t.id = new.transcript_id;END
CREATE TRIGGER search_segment_delete AFTER DELETE ON transcript_segments BEGIN DELETE FROM search_index WHERE "rowid" = -old.id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "extractions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recording_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "model_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "json" TEXT NOT NULL, "valid" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("valid" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER search_extraction_insert AFTER INSERT ON extractions BEGIN DELETE FROM search_index WHERE kind = 'extraction' AND recording_id = new.recording_id;INSERT INTO search_index (recording_id, kind, body) SELECT e.recording_id, 'extraction', group_concat(j.value, ' ') FROM extractions AS e,json_tree(e.json)AS j WHERE e.id = (SELECT e2.id FROM extractions AS e2 WHERE e2.recording_id = new.recording_id ORDER BY e2.created_at DESC, e2.id DESC LIMIT 1) AND j.type = 'text' GROUP BY e.id;END

CREATE TRIGGER search_extraction_update AFTER UPDATE OF json ON extractions BEGIN DELETE FROM search_index WHERE kind = 'extraction' AND recording_id = new.recording_id;INSERT INTO search_index (recording_id, kind, body) SELECT e.recording_id, 'extraction', group_concat(j.value, ' ') FROM extractions AS e,json_tree(e.json)AS j WHERE e.id = (SELECT e2.id FROM extractions AS e2 WHERE e2.recording_id = new.recording_id ORDER BY e2.created_at DESC, e2.id DESC LIMIT 1) AND j.type = 'text' GROUP BY e.id;END

CREATE TRIGGER search_extraction_delete AFTER DELETE ON extractions BEGIN DELETE FROM search_index WHERE kind = 'extraction' AND recording_id = old.recording_id;INSERT INTO search_index (recording_id, kind, body) SELECT e.recording_id, 'extraction', group_concat(j.value, ' ') FROM extractions AS e,json_tree(e.json)AS j WHERE e.id = (SELECT e2.id FROM extractions AS e2 WHERE e2.recording_id = old.recording_id ORDER BY e2.created_at DESC, e2.id DESC LIMIT 1) AND j.type = 'text' GROUP BY e.id;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "action_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "recording_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "extraction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES extractions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NULL, "due_iso" TEXT NULL, "t_ms" INTEGER NULL, "done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("done" IN (0, 1)), "done_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "jobs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recording_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "step" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "progress" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "error_code" TEXT NULL, "error_detail" TEXT NULL, "waiting_reason" TEXT NULL, "not_before" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "checkpoint" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "definition" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "filename_pattern" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mind_maps" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recording_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "extraction_id" TEXT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "model_id" TEXT NULL, "json" TEXT NOT NULL, "node_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vault_targets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "handle" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "routing_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL, "match" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vault_targets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sub_path" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "filename_pattern" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exports" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recording_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "target_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES vault_targets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "rel_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("recording_id", "target_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "models_installed" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "installed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminder_exports" ("item_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "recording_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recordings (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "calendar_item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "reminder_calendar_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exported_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("item_key"));
